title: NFL Prop Analytics Step 7 Eligible Player Selection + Prop Page Handoff
step_name: Eligible Player Selection + Prop Page Handoff
scope: Select only players already admitted by frozen Steps 5-6 and build an exact player handoff for the future prop page. PENDING players may be navigation-selectable but keep the prop-analysis gate closed. UNAVAILABLE/CLOSED/UNVERIFIED/depth-unverified players are excluded. No props, odds, projections, Passing Yards changes, or existing NFL market changes.

required: frozen Step 6 exact ESPN athlete id

selection_contract.admission: Step 5 roster verified + source_count>=2 + Step 6 exact depth verified + availability in PENDING or AVAILABLE.
selection_contract.pending_rule: PENDING player may be selected for navigation/handoff, but prop_analysis_gate_open must remain false.
selection_contract.available_rule: AVAILABLE player may be selected with prop_analysis_gate_open=true.
selection_contract.identity_rule: Step 7 never creates or name-matches a new player; exact Step 6 ESPN athlete id is carried forward.

handoff_contract.prop_page_ready_meaning: Navigation/context handoff only; does not imply sportsbook or model analytics are unlocked.
handoff_contract.downstream_rule: Future prop page must preserve prop_analysis_gate_open and availability_state exactly.

acceptance: Only exact Step 6 player IDs with verified roster/depth and PENDING or AVAILABLE availability may appear in the Step 7 selector.
UNAVAILABLE, CLOSED, UNVERIFIED, depth-unverified, single-source, or unverified identities never appear as Step 7 candidates.
PENDING player handoff is navigation-ready but prop_analysis_gate_open=false.
AVAILABLE player handoff may carry prop_analysis_gate_open=true.
Deep-link player selection resolves deterministically through ks_pa_player using exact ESPN athlete id.
Handoff preserves matchup key, exact ESPN event id, exact player id, team, position, depth role, and availability state.
Step 6 product module and ledger remain byte-identical.
390/768/1440 Step 7 selection UI has no horizontal overflow.
Public production proof passes before Step 7 is declared GREEN + FROZEN.
next_step_after_freeze: Step 8 — Prop Page Shell + Market Navigation
